prerequisites: Node.js 20 and npm. CI builds on Node 20, `.nvmrc` names Node 20, and `package.json` asks for Node 19 or 20. The README still names Node 18.

steps.title: Install the dependencies
steps.text: CI installs with the `--legacy-peer-deps` flag. Without it, `npm ci` stops: it reports that `package-lock.json` is not in sync with `package.json`.

steps.title: Set the API URL (optional)
steps.text: `npm start` reads `.env.development`, so the app calls the Greenstand dev wallet API at `https://dev-k8s.treetracker.org/wallet/v2` (`REACT_APP_WALLET_API_ROOT`). To use a local wallet API instead, put its URL in `.env.local`. For example, treetracker-wallet-api listens on port 3006 by default:

steps.title: Run the tests
steps.text: `CI=true` runs the tests once, as in CI. Without it, `npm test` starts in watch mode. At this commit, 44 tests pass and 6 are skipped.

steps.title: Build the app
steps.text: The build goes to the `build/` folder.

steps.title: Start the app
steps.text: Open http://localhost:3000. The app sends you to a login page. To sign in, you need a wallet account on the API that the app calls.
